input: Plan a guided museum tour for the kids

gold.taskTitle: Plan a guided museum tour for the kids
gold.taskDescription: Organize a guided museum tour experience tailored for children.

questions.title: Which museum are you planning to visit?
questions.description: Identify the specific museum the user has in mind.

questions.title: How many children are joining the tour?
questions.description: Determine the group size to help with logistics and booking.

questions.title: What are the ages of the children attending?
questions.description: Understand the age range to match content and tour difficulty appropriately.

questions.title: What date or timeframe are you targeting for the visit?
questions.description: Pin down a preferred date or window to guide scheduling and availability checks.

questions.title: Do you want a professional guide or a self-guided audio tour?
questions.description: Clarify the type of guided experience preferred for the group.

questions.title: Is there a specific theme or exhibit the kids should focus on?
questions.description: Understand whether there is a subject area, such as dinosaurs, space, or art, to prioritize.

questions.title: What is your budget for the tour and any admission fees?
questions.description: Establish financial constraints to ensure recommendations stay within range.
